In1.Cu.rule: continuous ground except physical antipads; no signal or RTN intrusions. Pure anti-pad connectivity screen is not a native fill.

USB.In1.Cu: continuous GND; no signal or RTN tracks/fills
USB.B.Cu: continuous GND immediately under In2; no RTN copper or foreign signal routes
USB.In2.Cu: USB routes plus surrounding GND; prohibit RTN tracks/fills/vias in the reserved region
USB.drills: Physical signal/ground via and connector-hole antipads are explicit exceptions, not proof of continuous reference. Plane necks must be checked after fills.

antenna.allowed: Only these two existing baseboard capacitors plus their dedicated supply/ground connections are permitted inside the conservative project component box. No enclosure item receives an exception.
antenna.RF_status: Engineering trial, not manufacturer approval; loaded-enclosure RF qualification remains.
